# H.M Media

> H.M Media is an AI creative studio for brands in the UAE, GCC and Middle East: AI product visuals, AI video ads, chatbots, apps, automation and agency services.

H.M Media is an AI creative studio and creative agency founded by Hussein Mlhem (حسين ملحم). It is based in the UAE and works with brands across the GCC, the Middle East and remotely worldwide, in Arabic and English. Prices below are starting points in UAE dirhams (AED); every project gets an exact quote before work starts.

## How to hire

- WhatsApp / phone: +971 54 288 2950 (https://wa.me/971542882950)
- Email: hussein.mlhem@gmail.com
- Website: https://h-m.agency/ (English), https://h-m.agency/ar/ (Arabic)
- Typical reply time: within 24 hours

- **AI Product Visuals** (from AED 499): Studio-quality product photos. No photoshoot.

## H.M One: business software

H.M One is our business operations platform for companies in the UAE and the region. Your company gets its own private workspace in Arabic and English, and you activate only the Solutions you need. If what you need does not exist yet, we build it for you. Page: https://h-m.agency/one/ (Arabic: https://h-m.agency/ar/one/).

Solutions available today:

- [HR Management](https://h-m.agency/one/hr/): Employee records, organization chart, contracts, documents, leave, requests, onboarding, offboarding and end-of-service estimates.
- [Attendance & Leave](https://h-m.agency/one/attendance/): Clock in and out, monthly attendance records, fingerprint file import, public holidays and leave requests.
- [Payroll](https://h-m.agency/one/payroll/): Monthly payroll periods calculated from contracts, allowances and loan installments, with approval, payment marking and payslips.
- [Facility Management](https://h-m.agency/one/facility/): Clients, properties, units and work orders with team assignment, work logs, cost tracking and payment collection.
- [Asset Management](https://h-m.agency/one/assets/): A register of equipment and devices with tag, serial number, purchase data and assignment to employees or properties.
- [Preventive Maintenance](https://h-m.agency/one/maintenance/): Recurring maintenance plans per asset that generate one work order for each due date.
- [Procurement](https://h-m.agency/one/procurement/): Suppliers, purchase requests, supplier quotations, purchase orders and goods receipt, with approval on requests and orders.
- [Inventory & Spare Parts](https://h-m.agency/one/inventory/): Items, warehouses and a stock movement ledger; balances per item and warehouse come from posted movements.
- [Finance & Expenses](https://h-m.agency/one/finance/): Itemized VAT invoices, credit notes and expense claims with approval, plus payments, allocations, receipts and reversals.
- [Shared Platform](https://h-m.agency/one/platform/): Company workspace, users and roles, approvals, notifications, reports, guides and support, subscription screens, Arabic and English.

Custom Solutions are built on request. Pricing is quoted per company; request it on WhatsApp.

## FAQ

### Can you build a custom AI app or chatbot for my business?

Yes. Tell us the problem and we propose the solution, the timeline and a quote.

### Are your prices fixed?

No. They are starting points. You get a clear quote before any work starts.

### Do you use AI in the creative process?

Yes, where it adds value. The final output stays controlled and on brand.

### How fast can you deliver a project?

Simple designs start within 24–72 hours. Larger projects get a timeline after the brief.

### What do you need from me before starting?

Your goal, logo or brand guidelines, audience, content and deadline.

### How many revisions are included?

We agree on deliverables, revisions and timeline before starting.

### Can I request a one-time project instead of a monthly package?

Yes. One-time projects are welcome.

### Do you work with clients outside the UAE?

Yes. We work remotely with clients across the UAE, the GCC and worldwide.
